["CREATE TABLE "resource" (
  "resource_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "resource_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "location" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("resource_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "personnel" (
  "personnel_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "phone_number" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "position" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("personnel_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "monitoring" (
  "monitoring_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "resource_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "personnel_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "monitoring_time" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "monitoring_point" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "water_quality_indicators" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "water_volume_data" REAL NOT NULL,
  "pollution_level" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("monitoring_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("resource_id") REFERENCES "resource" ("resource_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("personnel_id") REFERENCES "personnel" ("personnel_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "maintenance" (
  "maintenance_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "resource_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "personnel_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "maintenance_time" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "maintenance_content" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "maintenance_costs" REAL NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("maintenance_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("resource_id") REFERENCES "resource" ("resource_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("personnel_id") REFERENCES "personnel" ("personnel_id")
);"]

);", "CREATE TABLE "chat_records" (
  "sender_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "message_content" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "read_time" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("sender_id", "receiver_id", "send_time"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("sender_id") REFERENCES "users" ("user_id"),

);", "CREATE TABLE "user_group_joins" (
  "user_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "group_chat_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "join_time" TEXT NOT NULL,

["CREATE TABLE "student" (
  "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "date_of_birth" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "phone_number" TEXT,
  "home_address" TEXT,
  "registration_eligibility" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("student_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "course" (
  "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "course_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "credits" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "instructor" TEXT,
  "class_time" TEXT,
  "location" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("course_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "examination_result" (
  "result_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "examination_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "grade" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "examination_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("result_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("student_id") REFERENCES "student" ("student_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "registration" (
  "student_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "course_id" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "registration_time" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("student_id", "course_id", "registration_time"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("student_id") REFERENCES "student" ("student_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("course_id") REFERENCES "course" ("course_id")
);"]

  "professional_skills" TEXT,

  "team_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "team_name" TEXT,

);", "CREATE TABLE "service_task" (
  "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "customer_name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "customer_phone" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_date" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_address" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_type" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "service_duration" REAL NOT NULL,

  "task_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,

  "product_category" TEXT,
  "default_price" REAL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id")

  "style_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "associated_product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "style_name" TEXT,
  "sale_price" REAL,
  "original_price" REAL,
  "is_default_style" INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY ("style_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("associated_product_id") REFERENCES "product" ("product_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "feature" (
  "feature_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "associated_product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "feature_name" TEXT,
  "feature_value" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("feature_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("associated_product_id") REFERENCES "product" ("product_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "sku" (
  "sku_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "associated_style_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "size" TEXT,
  "stock_quantity" INTEGER,
  PRIMARY KEY ("sku_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("associated_style_id") REFERENCES "style" ("style_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "photo" (
  "photo_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "associated_style_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "photo_url" TEXT,
  "thumbnail_url" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("photo_id"),
  FOREIGN KEY ("associated_style_id") REFERENCES "style" ("style_id")
);"]

);"]

);", "CREATE TABLE "maintenance_detail" (

);"]

  "id_card_back_photo" TEXT,
  "facial_recognition_status" INTEGER,
  "avatar" TEXT,
  "nickname" TEXT,
  "gender" TEXT,
  "age" INTEGER,
  "location" TEXT,
  "personal_introduction" TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id")
);", "CREATE TABLE "products" (
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "seller_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "title" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "detailed_description" TEXT,
  "condition_description" TEXT,
  "original_price" REAL,
  "selling_price" REAL NOT NULL,
  "category" TEXT,
  "transaction_location" TEXT,
  "price_negotiation_range" TEXT,
  "validity_period" TEXT,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id"),

);", "CREATE TABLE "product_photos" (
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "photo_index" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "photo_url" TEXT NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("product_id", "photo_index"),

);", "CREATE TABLE "transactions" (
  "transaction_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "buyer_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "product_id" INTEGER NOT NULL,
  "status" TEXT NOT NULL,

  "transaction_amount" REAL NOT NULL,
  "transaction_location" TEXT,
  "transaction_method" TEXT,
  "evaluation" TEXT,

  "gender" TEXT,
  "identification_number" TEXT NOT NULL,

);", "CREATE TABLE "flight" (

);"]
